verification.explanation: Photographs are masked for text-pixel checks because Chrome can resample the same JPEG differently between loads. Image response hashes and exact image positions/sizes are checked separately. Published-copy text comparisons tolerate one RGB level per channel, observed between repeat captures with unchanged fonts; strict pixel counts and raw unmasked counts are retained.
